recognize_zh: 高倍下可見一個特別大的巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、核深度分葉呈鹿角狀（staghorn/hyperlobated），周圍還有數個大型巨核細胞散在分布而非緊密成簇，背景造血細胞豐富；大而成熟、分葉過度的巨核細胞是本態性血小板增多症（ET）的特徵。
features: Enlarged megakaryocyte with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and deeply lobulated, hyperlobated ('staghorn') nucleus
Additional large mature megakaryocytes nearby, loosely scattered rather than forming tight clusters
Megakaryocyte nuclei show mature chromatin without bulbous hyperchromatic cloud-like forms
Hypercellular background with normal-appearing maturing erythroid and granulocytic precursors
No reticulin fibrosis or blast aggregates apparent on H&E at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and increased megakaryocytes. The megakaryocytes include enlarged mature forms with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm and deeply lobulated, hyperlobated staghorn-like nuclei; they are loosely dispersed or form only loose groups, without tight clustering or bulbous hyperchromatic nuclei. Erythroid and granulocytic maturation appear unremarkable and no increase in blasts is evident. Findings are consistent with essential thrombocythemia in the appropriate clinical context (sustained thrombocytosis, JAK2/CALR/MPL mutation, grade 0-1 reticulin).

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are atypical with bulbous, hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and high N:C ratio, form dense clusters, and the marrow shows granulocytic proliferation with reduced erythropoiesis.
Shows panmyelosis with prominent erythroid and granulocytic proliferation and pleomorphic megakaryocytes of variable size, together with elevated hemoglobin/red cell mass.
Megakaryocytes are small and hypolobated ('dwarf') in a granulocyte-dominated marrow; BCR::ABL1 testing excludes it.
Megakaryocytes may be increased but lack the giant hyperlobated forms and the marrow is not a clonal MPN; clinical cause (iron deficiency, inflammation) and absent driver mutation support reactive.
